links.outcome: Readability (FKRE, SMOG) of ChatGPT responses to patient surgery questions
links.effect: Mean FKRE 24.3 ± 7.35 and mean SMOG 13.9 ± 1.22, indicating a difficult to very difficult reading level best suited for university graduates.
links.quote: The mean FKRE score was 24.3 ± 7.35 and the mean SMOG score was 13.9 ± 1.22, indicating a difficult to very difficult reading level best suited for university graduates.
